title: Case studies – VOOL charging in offices, residences and fleets
description: Real sites with numbers: 45 chargers on one 125 A connection, 300 chargers for Omniva, 40 chargers serving 100 users in one office building.

sections.title: What VOOL does on real sites
sections.lead: Numbers from our customers and from sites built by our partners.

items.title: Omniva: 300 chargers for couriers
items.text: VOOL supplies Omniva with 300 chargers across Estonia over five years. The first 50 or so went to Tallinn, Tartu, Kuressaare and Rakvere.

items.title: Hansabuss: electric buses at existing hubs
items.text: The bus operator charges its electric fleet at its Latvian hubs and at drivers’ homes, without major changes to the infrastructure.

items.title: Alexela: turnkey charging for its customers
items.text: The energy company offers VOOL chargers, load management and smart charging to private and business customers in Estonia and Latvia.

sections.eyebrow: Built by our partner AMP X VOLT, Luxembourg
sections.title: Partner sites

items.title: Business campus, Hamm
items.text: More than 100 chargers on multi-level load management. One tenant runs 45 chargers on a single 125 A connection.

items.title: Office building, Mersch
items.text: 40 chargers shared by 11 companies. About 100 users charged 75 MWh in 3,000 sessions within six months.

items.title: Residence, Steinsel
items.text: 74 parking spaces. Owners ordered 19 chargers within three weeks of the shared installation.

items.title: Residence, Luxembourg City
items.text: Two buildings. More than 20 private chargers ordered since the shared parts were installed.

items.title: Production plant
items.text: 22 AC chargers for a new building at an industrial site in Luxembourg.
